entities.summary: Berber Saharan, a notable figure in the history of Morocco, associated with Ancient and Medieval Morocco (1040–1147). Preceded by Almoravid Dynasty and Islamic. Their legacy influenced Almohad Dynasty and Marinid Dynasty.
